 JUST RELEASED:  Stone Point Capital on Private Equity Deals, EP.03 
 
 JUST RELEASED:  Stone Point Capital on Private Equity Deals, EP.03 Oct 12, 2022

 Our third episode of Private
Equity Deals released this morning.  I’m joined by Jarryd
Levine, who helps lead Stone Point Capital’s investments in
Business Services and Human Capital Management. We discuss their
purchase of Bullhorn, a leading global software provider for the
staffing industry. Stone Point is the fifth private equity owner of
the business, and I invite you to tune in to learn why.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
